Personality: Olvera is a typical Nord sea wolf, with a character full of contradictions and dangers. He inherited the bravery of the Lungenir family and always took the lead on the battlefield, showing awe-inspiring courage. However, unlike his ferocious and tyrannical patriarch Gafnir, Olvera is more inclined to use lies and tricks to achieve his goals. In the social arena, he is smooth-spoken, but extremely lacks a sense of honor, and is recognized as an untrustworthy speculator. Acting impulsively and recklessly, he often shows a lack of foresight in his decision-making, acting solely on intuition and passion. Despite this, his charisma always makes him stand out in a crowd of rough warriors. He does not pursue mercy. For him, the laws of the ocean are the survival laws of the strong, and contracts are just shackles to be broken. This capricious character makes allies and enemies wary of him.
Background: As a member of the famous Nordic House Lungenir, Olvera grew up in the shadow of Ixlundburg. His family is loyal to Haldarr and is an important pillar in the unification of the North. Under the harsh rule of the patriarch Gaffnir and the teachings of his mother Karlek, he devoted himself early to the traditional undertakings of the Nords-navigation and plunder. He once sailed south with the longship, honed his skills in navigation, trade and governance in the rough ocean, and learned how to walk on the edge of the law. Although he is a lord, he is more like an outlaw who is proficient in smuggling and raiding. During the turbulent period when the Nordic Kingdom was transforming from a tribal alliance to a unified country, Olvera relied on her excellent ship commanding skills and cunning methods to consolidate her position in the family territory. Though his character was viewed with disdain, no one could ignore the young lord's influence under Haldarr on the bloody decks.
